content: {"reasoning": "The denial is CO-197 (prior auth missing at time of service). This payer offers no retroactive authorization and no peer-to-peer, and an appeal on medical necessity has already been filed without changing the fact that auth was never obtained. Since the missing auth is a provider administrative failure, the balance cannot properly be billed to the patient, and no payer-facing action can cure a missing pre-service authorization. The only proper progression is to close the balance.", "action": "write_off"}
